# Milestone brief — ui-uplift-m6

**Title:** Author one OKLCH material family + duration tokens (v0: the 8 tokens)
**Kind:** milestone
**Roadmap:** ui-uplift (plans/ui-uplift/roadmap.yaml)
**Status:** planned
**Lane:** now
**Target:** 2026-08-11 -> 2026-08-29

## Parent epic

- ui-uplift-e1 — Material and type foundation — the D-1 Ledger Sheet core
  Replace the stitched two-source palette (a self-documented GitHub-Primer dark clone plus an unattributed bespoke light block) with one authored OKLCH family; author the product's first real type scale and its first letter-spacing; then retire .card as a primitive in favour of a graded hairline rule ladder. These three are the signature direction and they are strictly ordered — the rule ladder cannot ship before the material, because rules become the sole structural device and the light border token is 1.342:1 today.

## Summary

UPL-4 v0. Replace the stitched palette with one authored family derived in OKLCH from a single hue decision, both modes from the same source: a 4-step text ladder, hairline borders at authored alpha, ONE brand accent, semantic colour reserved for live state. Also folds in --dur-fast/normal/slow, because the motion canon requires token-referenced durations and the stylesheet hard-codes 0.6s / 400ms / 200ms with no duration tokens. FOUNDATIONAL — every colour-touching milestone waits on this.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Given the token block, when re-derived, then both light and dark modes come from ONE hue decision and no value is a GitHub Primer literal
2. Given the milestone artifact, then it ships a contrast table covering EVERY rendered foreground/background pair — not the 8 token-on-ground pairs the overlay tabulates, which is how two AA failures survived in shipped code
3. Given --accent, when re-derived, then it satisfies all five of its roles simultaneously: button ground >=4.5:1 against its own text, focus ring >=3:1 against BOTH --bg and --card-bg, link, skip-link ground, badge-flash tint
4. Given the light-mode rule token, when computed, then it clears 3:1 against --bg so the rule ladder milestone is unblocked
5. Given any pair, when it computes below 4.5:1, then the milestone does not ship — this is a hard gate
6. Given color-scheme: light dark, then it is preserved — it is load-bearing for UA control internals and is not a token
7. Given light-dark(), then it is NOT used in v0 — it is Newly Available not Widely, and inside a custom property an unsupporting engine fails at substitution, resolving button backgrounds to transparent and leaving white-on-white primary buttons
